tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.
keywords_missing: specific domain tools not listed in master CV

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] Orogoo Service Inc
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in joining Orogoo Service Inc. With over 5 years of professional backend and e-commerce experience building and supporting large enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud and Java technologies.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Java
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring for enterprise clients.

bullets.label: REST APIs & Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub.

bullets.label: Database Optimization
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed while optimizing FlexibleSearch queries.

bullets.label: DevOps & Cloud
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving my notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, making me available to start from 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background matches your needs.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and SAP Commerce Cloud expertise from Rockwell Automation and Shell to Orogoo Service Inc, contributing strong Java, Spring, and API integration skills to help scale your digital platforms and deliver robust backend solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Java experience to build scalable e-commerce solutions at Orogoo Service Inc.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am a backend and SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am interested in opportunities at Orogoo Service Inc. My German residence permit is valid, and I am available from 16.12.2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the [Post] position at Orogoo Service Inc. With over 5 years of backend experience specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and Spring across enterprise projects at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-equipped to contribute to your engineering team.

I hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16.12.2026 following my notice period ending 15.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
